timing.parallelism: single process, single thread unless noted

comparison.max_reticulations: matched to the generating network per condition
comparison.seed_scheme: replicate i uses seed SEED + i for simulation and search
comparison.stochasticity_note: Both searches are stochastic. PhyNetPy is seeded per replicate; PhyloNet's command-line interface is not seeded here, so its variation across replicates is uncontrolled. Aggregates over 3 replicates are what the paper reports; per-replicate values are retained under conditions[*].replicates.
comparison.timing_note: PhyloNet wall_s includes JVM startup; self_reported_s does not. PhyNetPy wall_s is in-process with modules already imported; the one-time import cost is meta.phynetpy_import_s. Compare self_reported_s against PhyNetPy wall_s for like-for-like.
